stations.title: Ambrose
stations.say: Put my rules in the laptop.

stations.title: Dorrit guesses
stations.text: When Ambrose is out, each slip is a guess.

captions: Ambrose wants his counter rules in the laptop, starting with Edwina's clock.
When he is out, Dorrit guesses: overdue or not, free or not, which shelf.
You write the rules with if, else, and and or, in four tasks.
Now each slip gets one answer, the one Ambrose would give.
The program can choose now. Next, Kasimir wants it to repeat.
